limitations: Historical candidate and imposed road scenarios only; not current route guidance or an official warning.
Residential population is modelled, not a measured event casualty, and reporting units are AOI intersections.
Accepted flood likelihood, FPPS, action class and age equity are unavailable.
Generic legacy vehicle access is omitted; select a service and travel mode for a comparable modelled result.
reporting_scope: Only the intersection of each subdistrict with this AOI is reported; full-subdistrict totals and rankings are not inferred.

services.reason: Main-road access has no separately qualified result; road connectivity does not establish passability.
